description.fr: Glissez à toute vitesse le long d'un toboggan astral, ballon au pied !

names.jp: ディスティニークラウド

description.en: Pull the clouds from the sky down in a tornado to stop the ball!
description.fr: Déchaînez la fureur des cieux en créant une tornade pour bloquer le ballon !

names.jp: フローラルデスペアー

description.en: Rise from a blossoming rose and charge the ball with crimson energy!
description.fr: Alliez-vous à Mère Nature pour insuffler force et grâce au ballon.

description.en: This shot begins with a dying flower and ends with a consuming black hole.
description.fr: Chargez d'énergie le cœur d'une fleur flétrissante pour illuminer le terrain.

description.en: Draw a soft pink heart with your blade, then thrust to release a spellbinding shot toward the goal.
Shatter the air with a hammering blow to send the ball rocketing in a violent burst of energy.
Launch a barrage of strikes on the ball, compressing energy into a glowing lunar sphere before hammering it from above.
Combine the powers of all of your teammates into the ball!
description.fr: Combinez toute l'incroyable puissance de vos coéquipiers dans le ballon !

names.jp: グレートマックスなオレ

description.en: Form a powerful tornado that dwarfs the goal and obliterate it!
description.fr: Entourez-vous d'une sphère immense qui réduira le but adverse à néant !

description.en: Encase the ball in a prism and fire it out in a rainbow onslaught!
description.fr: Enfermez le ballon dans un prisme et laissez-le irradier le but adverse !

description.en: Rush the enemy with an army of clones, and walk away serenely with the ball.
description.fr: Déployez une armée de clones pour intimider l'ennemi et conserver le ballon !

names.jp: シェルビットバースト

description.en: Multiply the power of one shot into seven!
description.fr: Transformez un tir en sept et envoyez une déferlante de ballons dans les buts !

names.jp: ペンギン・ザ・ハンド

description.en: Summon a bracelet of living penguins and use them to stop the ball!
description.fr: Appelez une escouade de manchots à la rescousse pour défendre les buts !

description.en: Charge up the magnetic fields around the ball and send it hurtling into goal!
description.fr: L'aura magnétique dont vous enveloppez le ballon l'attirera au fond du but !

description.en: Take the power of three up into space and send that goal home!
Summon a sky-splitting thunderstorm and let lightning crash down upon the pitch as the ball surges forward.
Three players race in a line to punch through the opposition.
description.fr: Trois joueurs courent l'un derrière l'autre et anéantissent toute opposition.

description.en: Stun your opponent with feats of perfectly precise acrobatics!
description.fr: Votre rival restera sans voix devant la précision millimétrée de vos mouvements.

description.en: Unleash a titanic kick from the darkness, smashing the ball in a whirlwind of black and red power.

names.jp: ヴァルキリーフラッグ

description.en: With the gleam of a warrior maiden, charge forward to overwhelm your foe and snatch the ball amid a radiant storm.
From a crack in the void, unleash a crimson-black sword that slashes through the ball and enemies alike with deadly precision.
Turn your back and use your own aura to impale the ball and drop it harmlessly.
description.fr: Tournez le dos au ballon et libérez une aura d'énergie noire pour l'intercepter.

description.en: Summon a swirling shield of shadow and slam your opponent aside to guide the ball back under your control.

names.jp: ギガバイトスクリュー

description.en: Unleash a towering geyser and let a spiraling whirlpool engulf the ball to pull it under your control.
Erase the pitch from under your opponent's feet.

A move forged for destructive power. Turns the ball into a lethal weapon.
description.fr: Un arcane destructeur qui transforme le ballon en armes redoutable.

description.en: Channel the energy of God Hand into both your feet and assault the goal!
description.fr: Canalise l'énergie de la Main céleste dans les pieds et la projette dans les buts !

description.en: A deadly blade enrobed in black flames! Its destructive force is terrifying.
description.fr: Une lame effrayante entourée de flammes noires. Le cauchemar de tout gardien.

description.en: Hold on to your hats! This wind will push you right past your opponent!
description.fr: Glissez comme le vent pour passer votre adversaire !

description.en: An artistic shot that makes the ball sound out a powerful and beautiful melody.
description.fr: Un tir harmonique qui fait du ballon le point d'orgue d'une symphonie gagnante.

description.en: Smash into your foe like a tornado and then whisk the ball away.
description.fr: Filez sur votre adversaire à la vitesse du vent pour lui prendre le ballon !

description.en: Going left? Going right? You'll be long gone by the time your rival works it out!
description.fr: Personne d'autre que vous ne connaît la partition. Votre adversaire restera coi !

description.en: A vicious overhead shot that imbues the ball with a jet-black aura!
description.fr: Un tir acrobatique qui enveloppe le ballon d'une aura d'un noir intense.

description.en: Leap to an incredible height, then kick the ball down with all your might!
description.fr: Un impressionnant saut en hauteur suivi d'une frappe surpuissante !

names.jp: オーバーヘッドぺンギン

description.en: Gather the penguins' power into the ball, then strike a fierce overhead toward the goal!
Generate a monstrous aura and overwhelm opponents with a horrifying blow.

names.jp: レンサ・ザ・ウォール

description.en: Line up The Wall to block opponents' dribbles and turn into a moving fortress of defence.
もっこり丘から　巨大なモアイ像が出現！相手を突き上げて　遠くへと吹き飛ばす。
Strike the ball with a flurry of kicks to sharpen the ball into a diamond-bright shot.
Kick an ice-coated ball along an arcing path to freeze the opposition in their tracks.
Send forth a giant tangle of fisty fur to entangle the ball and weaken its force.

names.jp: ゾーン・オブ・ペンタグラム

description.en: Erect a circular barrier around you to create myriad reflections and stop enemy attacks.
Radiate a heavenly light to blind opponents and burst through in one swift move.
Spin the ball with both feet to charge energy and fire it like a devastating plasma cannon.

names.jp: ウズマキ・ザ・ハンド

description.en: Summon swirling waves that coalesce and form a colossal hand to reel in incoming shots.

names.jp: シューティングカット

description.en: Whip up a tornado with nimble footwork to weaken the ball and seize it instantly.

names.jp: ハイビーストファング

description.en: Strike with fangs from every part of your body to hunt your prey in bestial style.
Pool the power of three to summon a black hole,sucking in the opponent's shot.

names.jp: パーフェクトペンギン

description.en: Unite elite forces into the ball to form a flawless penguin that rushes straight for the goal.
Toss opponents into a lightning-charged tornado to shock them, then surge past.
Harnessing the power of the sun, this overhead kick turns the ball into a radiant bird that flies forth with unstoppable force.
Leap skyward with the power of your allies and smash the ball down in a meteor-like overhead strike.
Raise a shield forged from unwavering loyalty that grows brighter and stronger with your heart.
Spread your wings and strike from the sky with an overhead that slices through air to pierce the goal.

names.jp: ゴッドノウズ・インパクト

description.en: Call upon the beauty and lightning of the heavens to rock the earth and mark the dawn of a new myth.
Smash the ground with all your might, sinking the goalposts and deflecting the shot.
Unleash a beastly shot that bares its fangs at the goal, capable of felling even a bear.

names.jp: シロウサギダッシュート

description.en: Charge forward with a rabbit-like sprint and deliver a springing kick full of flair.
Strike with a sharp, freezing kick to unleash a three-fold blizzard at the goal.
Dive beneath the waves and dance like a mermaid, wrapping the ball in a veil of water to stop it.
Confuse the goalkeeper with a fierce bouncing shot fueled by the might of a giant ???.
Channel the rhythm and intensity of a perfect duo dance into a dazzling, unstoppable shot.

names.jp: ザ・エクスプロージョン

description.en: Charge the ball with rapid kicks, then unleash a powerful blast shot!
Become lightning itself, and fire a shot that reaches the heavens!
Summon the Wind and Thunder Majin, covering blind spots and taking Majin the Hand to the next level.
description.fr: Invoquez Fujin et Raijin, dieux du vent et du tonnerre, qui couvrent vos angles morts et améliorent considérablement la Main Magique.

description.en: Launch a shot of unfathomable power that transforms into a dragon, thrashing toward the goal.
Channel the power of a mighty dragon into your foot and strike with a sharp, roaring shot.
description.fr: Votre pied est infusé de la puissance d'un dragon pour un puissant tir rugissant.

description.en: Summon a tornado with three allies and send cloned balls hurtling at the goal from three directions.
Lure opponents into a massive labyrinth and slip past while they're lost in your cunning dribble.
Charge the ball with overflowing cold and turn it into unbreakable ice that pierces the goal.
Add explosive fizz to a Fire Tornado shot and unleash a deceptively powerful strike.

names.jp: キャスティングアーム

description.en: Unleash an arm-like aura to snatch any shot from the air—no matter the angle.
Ignite your foot with flames and kick the ball with scorching force for a fierce, direct shot at the goal.
Spin at blazing speed to create five colossal tornadoes and snatch the ball away.
Charge with unstoppable force to unleash a wild, bison-like shot at the net.
description.fr: Suite à une charge inarrêtable, propulsez un tir sauvage qu'un bison dans les filets.

names.jp: 特攻バッファロートレイン

description.en: Charge forward as a trio, kicking up a cloud of dust and trampling opponents like raging bulls.

names.jp: ペンギン・ザ・ゴッド＆デビル

description.en: Divine and demonic penguins converge on the ball, creating a force of opposites beyond measure.
description.fr: Des manchots divins et démoniaques se ruent vers le ballon ! La puissance née de leur opposition dépasse toute mesure..

description.en: Halt the ball in time with mysterious power and strike at the perfect moment.
description.fr: Arrêtez le ballon à temps grâce à un pouvoir mystérieux puis frappez au moment opportun.

description.en: Split the ball into five parts and send them flying toward the keeper in a dazzling display.
Gather solar energy to forge a guillotine and cut the ball with a scorching blade.
Call forth a trio of Majin, combining wind, thunder, and fire to defend against every shot
description.fr: Le troisième Majin entre en scène ! Vent, tonnerre et désormais feu s'unissent pour garantir une défense absolue.

description.en: Envelop the ball in a holy melody of light and sound, then strike it to purify everything in its path.
Ensnare the ball in a flawless, mesmerizing melody, controlling it and stopping it cold.
Infuse the ball with lunar power and whip it into a curving arc toward the goal.
Draw a royal crest in the air to unleash your determination and defend the goal at all costs.

names.jp: ダイナミック・コロナ

description.en: Hammer a swirling corona of solar fire down onto the ball with dynamic force.
Launch a flaming header that transforms into a firebird, gliding fiercely toward the goal.

names.jp: レッドホットチリ・メテオ

description.en: Rain down a massive meteor from the sky, blanketing the ground in shock and flame.
Merge three beings into one and behold the great Majin's descent, six arms ready to stop any incoming shot.
Soar high into the sky, spot your target and unleash a bullet-like shot that dives toward the goal.
description.fr: Envolez-vous dans les nuages, trouvez votre cible, et propulsez un tir rappelant une balle de pistolet dans les buts.

description.en: Sweep every approaching shot aside with a colossal iron fan infused with the power of a mighty dragon.
Transform into a colossal lion and snap at opponents to seize the ball.

names.jp: ファイアレモネード・ライジング

description.en: Strike with a blow carrying the hopes of your allies, sending the ball soaring onward with overwhelming power.

names.jp: シャーク・ザ・ディープ

description.en: Cloak the ball in a dark aura and launch a sharp strike that attacks the keeper like a feral shark.

names.es: Colapso del Cielo y la Tierra

description.en: Unleash a full-power shot with devastating force capable of splitting the heavens and rending the earth.
Compress your aura and catch any fierce shot with a diamondized hand.
description.fr: Contractez votre aura et arrêtez tout tir enflammé d'une main durcie comme le diamant.

description.en: Expand your aura and take on a gel-like form to absorb the force of every shot coming your way.
Cloak the ball in a raging blizzard and unleash ursine forbidden might.
Harden your arm into diamond to snatch the ball with a technique both rigid and remarkably fluid.
Polish the ball with a diamond-hardened kick to send it arcing just before the goal.
Split the ball and drill through with a glowing, high-intensity combination strike.
Gather swirling winds into the ball and launch it from the heavens toward the goal.

names.jp: イノセント・ドライブ

description.en: Surrounded by a cascade of stained glass, leap and shatter a crystal with a powerful strike.
description.fr: Niché au cœur d'une myriade de vitraux, brisez le cristal d'un tir sauté dévastateur.

description.en: Harness the raw fury of a swirling tornado to deliver a rough but devastating shot.

names.jp: ブルー・スターダスト

description.en: Merge countless blue stars into a single streak of light racing across the pitch.
Shape your inner force into blazing sunlight and drive the ball toward the goal in blinding light.
Send four dragons spiraling toward the goal with destructive power beyond human reckoning.

names.jp: オリオン・クロスバイパー

description.en: Strike alongside a shadowy double in a high-speed twin shot that hits with double power.
Soar beyond the atmosphere and send a star-shattering strike crashing downward.
description.fr: Envolez-vous au-delà de l'atmosphère afin de frapper un tir si dévastateur qu'il pourrait bien briser des étoiles.

names.jp: イナビカリ・ダッシュ

description.en: Keep the ball under control at blinding speeds. Pass by the opposition like lightning, leaving them thunderstruck.
description.fr: Déposez l'adversaire par une accélération fulgurante. La balle est aussi rapide que l'éclair.

names.jp: ホワイトダブルインパクト

description.en: Combine forces with a teammate to unleash a devastating blizzard-class shot that glimmers in silvery radiance.
A long shot which pierces like a spear retaining the spirits of past rulers. A divine demonstration of majesty.
description.fr: Tir long, vif comme une lance, subjuguant l'ennemi par l'âme du champion qui l'habite.

names.jp: コズミックブラスター

description.en: Send the ball streaking like a meteor to produce a supernova-level strike of unimaginable power.

names.jp: デスクラッシャーゾーン

description.en: Kick in sync with a shot clad in ice to drive a colossal lance of darkness straight into the net.
Merge countless shields into a single fortress, deflecting shots from every direction.
